question: Each of T, U, V, W, X, Y and Z has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. X has an exam on the third day of the week. Only three people has an exam between X and T. Z has an exam immediately after V and Y has an exam immediately after Z. W does not have an exam on Monday. Who has an exam on Thursday?
solution:
**Given:** Each of T, U, V, W, X, Y and Z has an exam on a different day of a week, 

Starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week.

1) X has an exam on the third day of the week.

2) Only three people have an exam between X and T.

3) Z has an exam immediately after V, and Y has an exam immediately after Z.

4) W does not have an exam on Monday.

Thus, the V has an exam on "Thursday."

The correct answer is **"Option 4".**
